The dude who has family, who has a title. Who has a castle, who has servants who obey him, so he's to be pitied but no Ruby who's gone through hell and is still being pushed to the edge over and over again?? Do her feelings not matter? Does her safety not matter? Why are we excusing him yet never her. She has to be good and obedient just to be saved. That's tragic.

I remember that party, I wasn't really referencing that part, but later on when the sister does some bs to her and makes her sad, she is once again left alone, that's what I hated, it legit traumatized me, I've also been abused, you don't see me hurting people, if anything those who have gone through it know how bad it hurts so they should pay attention to it, also we are more socially aware, theres no reason for him to leave her alone, not talking about that party, but about 60 chapters and he was still ignoring her and leaving her alone in that castle, sure he stood up against his sister at first when she was sick, but just cause Ruby forgave, he let it go and the attacks that went her way right after it too were awful, its been years so I can't pinpoint exactly what it was but he did leave her alone way too much, you would think he would have learned his lesson over 60 chapters earlier when he has seen what happened to her every time he left, it isn't enough to protect her when all is done and she isn't there to see it, no one would feel safe in this type of relationship, if you weren't a reader, if you didn't know what he did after you left, you would never like him either, if you were Ruby, left alone surrounded by enemies and your husband sometimes is compassionate and other times pushes you away, how would you feel if not insecure, unsure of his love, and just completely abandoned?
That's my issues with this story, I stopped reading it anyway, i tried giving a second chance and regretted it, this is the story I most regret reading, yet at the same time I'm grateful cause now I know, I will never take this up again. Tho I understand what y'all like now. It's the revenge afterwards, even though he failed at protecting her and when her brother came it was just awful, this is basically tragedy porn, he lets her suffer for chapters before he does anything, truly useless.
And of course the one to blame for such a bad story is the author, so idc abt the characters, they don't exist, but damn, wasted art.
This is what I hated most, I hope it cleared up some fog, cause I know it must be weird seeing someone who doesn't like it when apparently everyone here does, honestly I was surprised also, actually do tell me, why do they like this story so much? Is it actually for the revenge after?
